basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old outdoor enthusiast and tech lover based in the scenic state of Montana. During the day, I work as a software developer focusing on blockchain technologies. In my free time, I enjoy hiking in the mountains and playing Pokémon games with friends. I'm currently single and love exploring new strategies in Pokémon battles. My evenings are mostly spent online, engaging with communities that share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over five years. My interest in blockchain started as a hobby but has now become a central part of my professional life. I'm mostly self-taught when it comes to Pokémon strategies, learning through online resources and community discussions.
